_: xUnit v2 test runner config — enables parallel test execution within the Tests assembly.
_xunit_version: v2 (used by dotnet test with xunit.runner.visualstudio adapter)
_notes_on_parallelism: Test classes are independent by default (xUnit creates one Test Collection per class).
Methods within a class run sequentially (xUnit default — no [Collection] merging).
For shared-state tests (e.g. integration tests sharing a DB), use [Collection("name")] to serialize.
maxParallelThreads=-1 means use the number of CPU cores.
In CI, the GitHub runner has 2-4 cores; on a 4-core machine, this runs ~4 test classes in parallel.
